title: Secure ≥1 adopter + reuse/citation tracking
context: The project's Definition of Shipped requires at least one external group (lab, challenge/toolkit, or teaching program) to use or cite the benchmark, with a documented instance. Without an adopter, the benchmark is not 'shipped' — the deed is not delivered. This task, which follows the public release, completes the named outreach from pathology-image-benchmarks-partner-001, secures a commitment, and establishes reuse/citation tracking. The adopter/steward deadline is 2026-12-31; if no adopter is secured by ~2027-03-31, a pivot-or-mothball decision is required. See PLAN.md (M4, Partner/compute-path, Risks).
objective: Convert outreach leads from pathology-image-benchmarks-partner-001 into at least one documented commitment: a named external group (academic comp-path lab, MICCAI/Grand-Challenge organizer, WSI toolkit project, or teaching program) that uses or cites the benchmark. Document the commitment with the group name, the use/citation instance, and date. Establish reuse/citation tracking (e.g. a GitHub Discussions thread, a DOI citation tracker, or equivalent). Update the governance log.
acceptanceCriteria: At least 1 named external group (lab, challenge/toolkit, or teaching program) uses or cites the benchmark, with a documented instance (publication, workshop paper, GitHub repo reference, or curriculum use).
The commitment is documented in a governance log entry with: group name, type of use/citation, date, and a verifiable pointer (URL or reference).
Reuse/citation tracking is set up (e.g. DOI citation tracker, Semantic Scholar alerts, or GitHub Discussions thread) and the method is documented.
The adopter/steward deadline (2026-12-31) and pivot-or-mothball rule (~2027-03-31) are noted in the log.
The document is committed via PR (e.g. docs/governance/adoption-log.md).
output: An adoption log (committed via PR) documenting at least 1 named external adopter, their use/citation instance, and the reuse/citation tracking setup.
